data.name: Revolution 1.6-beta
data.author: Thumblegudget, Bredroll, QuantX, NexusQuille, Dr-RazdalByte + Others
data.description:
The Revolution mod brings Radar enhancements, a more immersive fog-of-war for island captures and other features.
v1.6 Beta new features: [list] [*] Helm and Radar screens are HD [*] QoL changes to the inventory screen map display/tooltips [*] Barges and Virus bots now actually have names. [*] Remove the EW pod [/list] v1.6 Beta speculative changes (may be reworked ore removd) [list] [*] Limit Manta centre hardpoint to medium bombs [/list]
v1.5: [list] [*] Improved UI for turret deployment by Dr-RazdalByte [*] Reduced network traffic/congestion sent by shared holomap cursor [*] Fixed captian's holomap markers [*] TV missile shows minimap and distances to target and laucher and has compass marks [*] Various performance/lag tweaks [*] Next generation aircraft RWR sensor [*] HUD assistance for guided/cruise missile operation [*] HUD horizon ladder can now be togged off/on by double tapping the map [*] Helm gets a basic HUD showing nearby islands and compass course [*] Turrets can now be moved around by ground vehicles pushing. [/list]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3496283808]v1.4 available here[/url]
[list] [*] Fog of war [*] Needlefish rebalance (reduced simulated Radar range) [*] AWACS rebalance (~10-12km max range again for a better feel) [*] Manta rebalance (less deadly against carriers for more air combat) [*] Bomb enemy factories to slow production [/list]
For full details on what the mod does, how you can contribute or request features see [url=https://cc2maps.com/revolution-mod/]https://cc2maps.com/revolution-mod/[/url]
The mod is based on UI Enhancer and Albatross AWACS, so you get those amazing benefits included.
